workflow_contracts.name: Intent to bounded mission
workflow_contracts.entry_criteria: A human intent exists, but outcome, authority, or constraints are incomplete.

failure_path.required_artifact: Failure receipt with last valid evidence, limit reached, and safe resumption condition

workflow_contracts.exit_proof: A bounded mission brief with owner, constraints, routes, gates, and evidence plan.
workflow_contracts.writeback: Store the approved mission receipt; do not infer approval from silence.

workflow_contracts.name: Research to evidence
workflow_contracts.entry_criteria: A bounded research question and source policy exist.

failure_path.required_artifact: Failure receipt with last valid evidence, limit reached, and safe resumption condition

workflow_contracts.exit_proof: A claim ledger, source set, synthesis, dissent note, and confidence statement.
workflow_contracts.writeback: Write claims and sources separately; preserve unresolved contradictions.

workflow_contracts.name: Build to verified artifact
workflow_contracts.entry_criteria: A scoped specification, verified repository lane, and acceptance test exist.

failure_path.required_artifact: Failure receipt with last valid evidence, limit reached, and safe resumption condition

workflow_contracts.exit_proof: A tested artifact, independent verification receipt, known-risk list, and reversible release plan.
workflow_contracts.writeback: Record code, test, build, and review receipts before promotion.

workflow_contracts.name: Story to responsible release
workflow_contracts.entry_criteria: An approved narrative brief, audience, rights model, and factual claim set exist.

failure_path.required_artifact: Failure receipt with last valid evidence, limit reached, and safe resumption condition

workflow_contracts.exit_proof: A rights-cleared release packet with exact copy, media, crops, accessibility text, and approval receipt.
workflow_contracts.writeback: Store source, prompt, export, review, and publication receipts separately.

workflow_contracts.name: Incident to safe recovery
workflow_contracts.entry_criteria: A bounded incident signal and accountable operator are present.

failure_path.required_artifact: Failure receipt with last valid evidence, limit reached, and safe resumption condition

workflow_contracts.exit_proof: An incident timeline, containment state, recovery proposal, rollback path, and operator decision.
workflow_contracts.writeback: Append a redacted incident receipt and prevention action; never expose private incident data publicly.

workflow_contracts.name: Learning to demonstrated mastery
workflow_contracts.entry_criteria: A learner goal, consent boundary, baseline, and success demonstration are defined.

triggers: Learner consent or accessibility need unresolved
Assessment does not match the goal

failure_path.required_artifact: Failure receipt with last valid evidence, limit reached, and safe resumption condition

workflow_contracts.exit_proof: A demonstrated capability, learner reflection, evaluator evidence, and next-practice plan.
workflow_contracts.writeback: Store only consented learning evidence and allow correction or deletion.

workflow_contracts.name: Marketplace adoption
workflow_contracts.entry_criteria: A user need, host environment, and authority boundary are known.

failure_path.required_artifact: Failure receipt with last valid evidence, limit reached, and safe resumption condition

workflow_contracts.exit_proof: A compatible pack plan with permissions, provenance, cost, rollback, and explicit install approval.
workflow_contracts.writeback: Record the installed version and permission receipt; no silent upgrades.

workflow_contracts.name: Memory and continuity
workflow_contracts.entry_criteria: A source artifact and an explicit memory scope are present.

failure_path.required_artifact: Failure receipt with last valid evidence, limit reached, and safe resumption condition

workflow_contracts.exit_proof: A source-linked memory atom with scope, confidence, contradiction state, and retention decision.
workflow_contracts.writeback: Write only approved scoped memory; preserve source links and correction history.
